name: GridPlacer
src_typeComment: Click/tap a cell to place the assigned prefab, snapped to the grid. Assign a GridComponent from the scene and this works immediately — the ground plane it raycasts against should sit on the same layer(s) as raycastMask (a flat plane/terrain collider under the grid is the usual setup). Targets a 3D (XZ) ground-plane raycast; for a 2D game, swap TryGetWorldPointUnderCursor to use raycastCamera.ScreenToWorldPoint(Input.mousePosition) instead — GridComponent's XY plane mode already supports it, only the input-to-world-point step here is 3D-specific.

src_serialized.name: grid
src_serialized.tooltip: The grid to place objects on.

src_serialized.name: placementPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Prefab instantiated when a valid, unoccupied cell is clicked.

src_serialized.name: raycastCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Camera used to convert screen clicks to world position. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: hoverHighlight
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional object moved to hover over the cell under the cursor each frame (e.g. a translucent highlight quad).

src_serialized.name: raycastMask
src_serialized.tooltip: Physics layers the placement raycast can hit — set this to your ground/grid plane's layer.

src_serialized.name: clickOccupiedRemoves
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, clicking a cell that is ALREADY occupied removes what's there instead of doing nothing — so one button both places and clears. Turn off if you want placement to be one-way and to drive removal yourself via ClearCell().

src_members.sig: public void RemoveAt(int x, int y)
src_members.name: RemoveAt
src_members.comment: Destroys whatever occupies a cell and frees it. Public so a "sell"/"demolish" button can call it too.

src_members.sig: public void ClearCell(int x, int y) => grid.Occupancy.SetValue(x, y, null)
src_members.name: ClearCell
src_members.comment: Frees a cell WITHOUT destroying its object — for when something else already handled the object's removal (it died, was pooled, was picked up) and only the grid bookkeeping needs updating.
